chainlink._sequencerNote: Chainlink does NOT publish an L2 Sequencer Uptime Feed on Arbitrum Sepolia (testnet, no SLA). OracleManager treats sequencerFeed == address(0) as 'skip sequencer check' — safe on testnet; this must be set before any mainnet deploy.

_heartbeats_s._note: Testnet feeds tick faster (~120s) than mainnet (86400s). OracleManager.MAX_STALENESS is per-token configurable; for Sepolia we still set 90000s so the same value works on either chain.

tokens._source: WETH9: Uniswap v3 Arbitrum Sepolia deployment 'Wrapped Native Token' (https://developers.uniswap.org/contracts/v3/reference/deployments/arbitrum-deployments). USDC: Circle native testnet USDC (https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses). Both verified 2026-06-03; cross-confirmed in aave-address-book/AaveV3ArbitrumSepolia.sol + sepolia.arbiscan.io.
tokens._poolNote: There is NO pre-seeded WETH/USDC v3 pool with material liquidity on Arbitrum Sepolia (developer testnet). The demo must create + seed it (Factory.createPool -> pool.initialize(sqrtP) -> NPM.mint). Obtain testnet USDC from https://faucet.circle.com/ and WETH by wrapping ETH.

deployment._note: FULL-FRESH redeploy (2026-06-05) — replaces the 2026-06-03 P3.10 stack. Picks up the moat events (QuoteFilled / SwapPriced) + CvammPricing.loadComponents at optimizer_runs=1500 (InflexionCore 23,934B, EIP-170 OK). A FRESH Stylus FairValueOracle was deployed (cargo stylus deploy, WSL2) and init'd via cast to the FRESH VolOracle — the prior FVO was set-once-init'd to the old vol, so reusing it would have orphaned the new vol's sigma_ref. Solidity stack via script/Deploy.s.sol (USDC=fresh dUSDC, STYLUS_FVO=fresh, SKIP_FVO_INIT=true). Fresh demo pair via script/DeployDemoMocks.s.sol; 9 markets + pool + ~$100k unprotected LP + funded tranches via script/SeedDemo.s.sol. VolOracle poked (sigma_ref initialized to the 0.5e18 floor); FVO.fairPremium verified live (fairRate ~0.847 at floor vol). _deployBlock is the subgraph startBlock — the moat dataset begins here.

stylus._note: Byte-identical Rust to the prior FVO (21702 B; wasm already activated by codehash) — redeployed only to obtain a fresh address whose set-once init() points at the fresh VolOracle.

libraries._note: Auto-deployed + linked by forge during the Deploy.s.sol broadcast (public library functions, delegatecall).

demo._note: Fresh numeraire-correct mock pair (dWETH < dUSDC so token1=dUSDC=numeraire) + seeded fee-500 pool + ~$100k UNPROTECTED LP position (for previews; tokenId 3218). dWETH oracle-priced via the real Chainlink ETH/USD feed. The live create->settle lifecycle (Path A + Path B) ran on 2026-06-05 — see lifecycle below; smokeTestSwapId = the Path-A swap (#1).

lifecycle._note: LIVE create->settle lifecycle on the FRESH stack (2026-06-05), short (300s) fee-500 market 0xb8bbd684…, settled live (no time-warp) at the Chainlink round bracketing each expiry. All amounts in USD (dUSDC 6dec). The MM is a fresh demo signer (the prior MM key was unavailable on the home PC); it deposited 5,000 dUSDC into UnderwriterVault, signed the Path-B quote, and its own collateral paid the Path-B settlement.

pathA_convexity._note: Path-A (cvAMM pool) convexity hedge: premium is a small fraction of MaxIL. Settled from the ConvexityVault.

pathB_routing._note: createSwapRouted picked the MM (Path B) because it strictly beat the cvAMM pool price; the MM's price was charged and the MM's OWN collateral was locked + paid out from UnderwriterVault.
